criteria_add.text: With denton's appeal allowed, standings_2026.txt names each deciding tiebreak step: alone, berwick, ashford and fairmont on 12 split on mini table points; with the protest, eastvale above ironside on season goals scored, 16 to 14, and berwick above ashford on their 1 to 0 meeting; with ironside's appeal, the four-club mini table splits berwick and ashford (6) from fairmont and ironside (3), each pair settled by its own meeting; all three, denton above ironside on its 3 to 0 win at ironside.
